showLabels.Name: Show Wall Height Labels
showLabels.Hint: Shows the height range of walls that have one on the Walls layer.

labelMinLength.Name: Minimum Wall Length for Labels
labelMinLength.Hint: Walls shorter than this many grid spaces don't show a height label, unless hovered, selected or highlighted. 0 shows labels on every wall.

WallConfig.Hint: Sources and tokens outside this elevation range ignore the wall. Leave a field empty for no limit.
WallConfig.WarnInverted: Top is below Bottom. The height is ignored and the wall blocks at every elevation.
WallConfig.WarnNoOverlap: This height range lies outside all of this wall's levels ({ranges}). The wall only blocks tokens and sources whose elevation is outside their level's range.
WallConfig.WarnOutside: {field} lies outside this wall's levels ({ranges}). It only matters for tokens and sources whose elevation is outside their level's range. A wall never reaches into a level it isn't assigned to.
WallConfig.WarnOutsideBoth: Bottom and Top lie outside this wall's levels ({ranges}). They only matter for tokens and sources whose elevation is outside their level's range. A wall never reaches into a level it isn't assigned to.
